name: Ligaments
type_description: Take on the Gristleizer effect; CV-controlled bias modulation
bom_parts_summary: CD4093 NAND, TL074 & TL071 op-amps, 2N3819 JFET, 1N4148 diode
components_evidence: BOM lists only part values/types (e.g. CD4093, TL074, TL071, 2N3819, 1N4148) with no package or mounting info (no 0805/SOIC/DIP/TO-92/THT/SMD stated anywhere on page)

lineage.quote: my take on the legendary Gristleizer effect, originally designed by Roy Gwinn and made legendary by Chris Carter of Throbbing Gristle

lineage.source_is: Mechlab's own '4Square' module page - a 4093 quad NAND Schmitt Trigger 4-oscillator module

other_links: YouTube demo video embedded on page
notes: Replaces original Gristleizer LFO with CD4093 NAND-based square-wave oscillators. Adds independent rate control over two oscillators, CV control over effect bias, and a 'Tear' feature adding oscillators for chaos. No HP or licence stated.
